texts.title: Texts
texts.intro_company: Replace the application's words with yours, in each language: your screens, mails and printed documents take them at once. The tax mentions stay as the law writes them.
texts.intro_installation: The application's words for every company of this installation, in each language. Each company can still replace them with its own. The tax mentions stay as the law writes them.

dialog.title: Change the text
dialog.marks: Keep these marks as they are: {{marks}}

refusals.empty: Write a text, or restore the original from the list.
refusals.too_long: This text is too long: shorten it.
refusals.placeholders: Keep the same marks as the original text, no more and no fewer, written the same way.
refusals.plural: Keep the same forms as the original text for a number (one, other…), each within its braces.
refusals.locked: This text cannot be changed: the law or the application sets it.
refusals.unknown_text: This text no longer exists in this version: open the list again.
refusals.language: This language is not offered for the screens.
refusals.changed: This text was changed meanwhile: close it and open it again to see the saved text.
refusals.unavailable: The text could not be saved: try again in a moment.
